reason: Both are brand owners that design and market branded fashion/lifestyle goods, selling through retail partners and their own stores. G-III is mainly apparel and accessories across 30+ owned and licensed brands. Deckers is mainly footwear (UGG, HOKA, Teva) with some apparel and accessories. The product overlap is only partial, since footwear is a minor line for G-III and apparel is minor for Deckers. The retail customer base and the wholesale-plus-direct model are similar. That gives overlap on customers and model but only partial overlap on product, so the grade is adjacent.
